id.description: A unique identifier for the announcement.

mediaFileType.description:
Audio announcement file type.
 * `WAV` - WAV File Extension.
 * `WMA` - WMA File Extension.
 * `3GP` - 3GP File Extension.

level.description:
Audio announcement file type location.
 * `ORGANIZATION` - Audio file is configured across organization.
 * `LOCATION` - Audio file is configured across location.
 * `ENTITY` - Audio file is configured on instance level.

isTextToSpeech.description: Indicates whether the announcement is a text-to-speech file.
